[P2] Document the simpler alternatives before proceeding

This adds a constructor-identity branch and a helper used by 13 classes, but the PR description does not state which simpler options were considered or why they were rejected. CONTRIBUTING.md rule 2.5 explicitly requires that analysis when adding logic. Without it, the approach cannot be approved under rule 9 even if the implementation is correct. Return to the design phase described in rule 8, document the alternatives and the reason for this choice, and obtain agreement before further implementation changes.
